subject.title: feat: adopt shared design system across ClawHub UI

question: Should maintainers require hosted CI/Vercel installability and inspectable proof before merging this stacked design-system UI migration?
rationale: The code diff appears plausible, but the PR intentionally depends on a private package and an open base branch, and current hosted validation cannot run through the normal gates.

options.title: Fix access and proof first
options.body: Wire the private design-system dependency for hosted CI/Vercel or make it accessible, attach inspectable proof, and merge only after the base PR is accepted.

options.title: Accept local-only validation
options.body: A maintainer may choose to rely on the contributor's local validation and private proof, but that intentionally accepts broken hosted checks until infrastructure catches up.

options.title: Pause behind base PR
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3018 lands or is replaced by a cleaner base branch.

recommendation.title: Fix access and proof first
recommendation.body: Wire the private design-system dependency for hosted CI/Vercel or make it accessible, attach inspectable proof, and merge only after the base PR is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current branch, appears in recent main history for the affected theme/test surface, and merged adjacent homepage changes.
